newsitem.title: USA: Five New Mexico youths wounded in fierce gunfight.
newsitem.headline: Five New Mexico youths wounded in fierce gunfight.

text.p: Five young men between the ages of 12 and 22 were wounded early Thursday in a fierce gun battle during a house robbery in Albuquerque, police said.

Three armed thieves broke into an apartment at around 1:30 a.m., waking up two brothers who were asleep on the couch. The brothers grabbed nearby weapons and all five people were seriously wounded in a hail of bullets.
Police said at least one semi-automatic weapon was used in the gunfight. "We're investigating to see if gangs or drugs were involved," police spokesman Tony Hererra said.
All five were taken to a hospital in serious condition.
Hererra said the three assailants, who are 16, 18, and 22, would be charged with attempted murder but the brothers, 12 and 18, might not face charges.
